provenance.checkpoint_hash_limitations: Parent SFT hashes are recorded in qwen-full.json. A CPT adapter weight hash was not included in these acquired evaluation reports; its field remains null. No new weights were downloaded for this comparison.

format_caveats: Instruction-baseline generation uses the pinned official chat template with enable_thinking=False; base/CPT/SFT generation uses the explicit manual ChatML training format.
Assistant-only NLL uses the same explicit manual ChatML inputs for all variants, not each model's native template. It is a controlled-format loss comparison, not native-best-quality evaluation.
The 64-token generation cap truncates longer answers; completions are exact recorded outputs, not edited or graded.
Questions, input messages and references are copied from the released held-out SFT file after exact ID/reference alignment. Study-note references are not verified ground truth.
quality: This is a small diagnostic evaluation. Adaptation lowers loss on this held-out sample, but outputs include unsupported assertions, mismatches, repetition and degenerate numbers. Lower NLL does not validate factuality, personality fidelity or app usefulness; no accuracy or preference grades are assigned.

accounting.note: The shared ledger is authoritative; this snapshot does not total subsequent operator inference requests.
